alarms.action: Sets M191; sets ST10 fault summary M199; stops conveyor motor Y10 immediately
alarms.condition: Motor overload input lost (MOL-1001, X13 OFF)
alarms.name: Motor Overload Alarm

alarms.action: Stops conveyor and raises jam alarm (M190) until reset
alarms.condition: Entry photo-eye PE-1002 stays blocked for more than 5.0 s while conveyor runs
alarms.name: Jam Alarm

conflicts.narrative_says: If entry photo-eye PE-1002 stays blocked for more than 5.0 s while conveyor runs, raise jam alarm
conflicts.program_says: T10 and the entry photo-eye detection logic are completely missing from the program

interlocks.cause: Motor overload (MOL-1001, X13 lost) or E-stop chain lost (ES-0001, X0 lost)
interlocks.effect: Conveyor motor M-1001 (Y10) stops immediately via ST10 fault summary (M199)

interlocks.cause: ST10 fault summary active (M199 ON) or not in auto mode (X2 OFF)

interlocks.effect: Reports pallet in position (M100) to ST20

steps.entry: Auto mode selected (SS-0003, X2) AND no ST10 fault active (M199 OFF)
steps.exit: Auto mode lost OR ST10 fault/stop occurs (M199 ON)
steps.name: Conveyor Running
